guide.setup: Face a high cable with elbows tucked at the sides and hands holding the attachment near chest height.
guide.execution: Extend the elbows until the arms are straight, then return only as far as the elbows can stay fixed by the sides.
guide.cues: Keep shoulders down. Move only at the elbows. Control the return.
guide.mistakes: Swinging the torso; elbows drifting forward; using partial reps; shrugging.
